title: Consolidate Kit Kinds and Merge Studio Into Sketchpad
description: There are only 5 kinds of kits: File kit (*.kit.semio.json), Folder kit (.semio/kit.db sqlite), Archive kit (*.kit.semio.zip, read-only), Remote kit (from semio/server), Temporary kit (in-memory). Remove everything else (such as indexdb-kits). All programming languages must support all kit kinds. Consolidate semio/studio into semio/sketchpad and semio/desktop. For file and folder kits use either the native electron API or the browser API. Pass all the native callbacks on desktop prop to sketchpad.
summary:
Consolidated @semio/studio into @semio/sketchpad and @semio/desktop:

1. **Inlined all studio.ts code into sketchpad/index.tsx**: SyncDoc interfaces, CrdtBackend (CrdtDoc wrapping Y.Doc), PersistenceProviders (SyncBinaryPersistenceProvider, createJsonFilePersistenceFactory, createSqliteFolderPersistenceFactory), JsonFileKitStore, FolderKitStore, SessionKitStore (with presence, history, granular subscriptions), and factory functions.

2. **Removed IndexedDB-based kit storage**: Removed createIndexeddbPersistenceFactory, createLocalFileProvider (IndexedDB file provider), LocalFileProviderConfig, and all IndexedDB persistence usage from sketchpad entrypoint and play site. Removed IndexeddbPersistence re-export from elements/ui.

3. **Updated all consumers**: Changed imports in vscode/webview.tsx, desktop/renderer.tsx, sites/play/index.tsx, and js/index.ts from @semio/studio to @semio/sketchpad.

4. **Removed @semio/studio from all config files**: Removed alias from vite.config.ts (sketchpad, play, vscode, desktop), removed path mappings from tsconfig.json (sketchpad, vscode), removed dependency from package.json (sketchpad, play, vscode, desktop).

5. **Extended Desktop type**: Added kitFolder and kitFile optional properties to Desktop type for native Electron IPC callbacks. Updated desktop/renderer.tsx to pass window.kitFolder and window.kitFile through the desktop prop.

6. **Added yjs direct dependency**: Added yjs to sketchpad/package.json since it was previously transitive through studio.

7. **Added @semio/sketchpad path mapping to js/tsconfig.json** since js/index.ts tests now import from @semio/sketchpad.

Kit kinds supported: File (*.kit.semio.json), Folder (.semio/kit.db), Archive (*.kit.semio.zip), Remote (SessionKitStore), Temporary (InMemoryKitStore).
